description: Check a fline.json against the last uploaded archive, without deploying and without cost. Answers either ok, or the reason each part was refused — edit and ask again until it is ok, then save the file. There is no port field and there is no need for one: the platform passes PORT and routes whichever port the process opens. An env_names entry may be an object carrying a literal value — {"name": "KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS", "value": "PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092"} — which is how a service that names an image is configured, since its ENTRYPOINT reads its whole configuration out of the environment and the platform cannot replace it. A value is permitted only on a service that names an image, is never a credential (name a password or token and leave the value empty; a human enters it), and stands alone: no ref, scope or bind beside it. A managed database's connection string is NOT written this way — use scope "managed" with ref naming the offering and no value. health_path, on a public service, starts with / and has at most 200 characters, with no query, fragment, spaces or "..".
name: check_config
title: Check fline.json
